bio_en: Artavazd (Artik) Tumanian was the second son of the great poet Hovhannes Tumanian. In 1918, while the enemy continued its attacks on the Armenian remnant gathered around the Armenian authority of Vaspurakan, he volunteered for the fighting. During the retreat that began at the end of March 1918 he was killed, his young life ending heroically. Hairenik recalled him on the fiftieth anniversary of his death in 1968.
